🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 4)
Channel: alert-runtime-monitoring  •  bug-type guess: unknown  •  alerts in group: 3

Symptoms:
  - 3 Datadog-bot alerts in #alert-runtime-monitoring within 5m08s (12:29:59Z / 12:33:24Z / 12:35:07Z), all `bot_id=B063S8NBW0M`
  - Slack MCP returned all 3 with redacted bodies (recurring gap) — no monitor name, no metric, no service tag extractable from the messages themselves
  - No DD error logs in `env:prod` during 12:25–12:40Z window (zero hits)
  - No DD monitors currently in `Alert` state covering the window (only 2 stale: id 227951254 last 2025-10-16; id 240123515 last 2025-12-15)

Trace IDs: none — no error logs to sample from
Likely cause: inconclusive. Closest temporal correlation is `[Synthetics] Method UI Grid and Dropdown Performance Test Midnight run` (monitor 123495390) which last triggered at exactly **12:30:00Z** (No Data) — but that monitor is `team:qa` and normally routes to #alert-system, not #alert-runtime-monitoring, so the correlation is suggestive, not proven. Pattern of 3 alerts in 5min with no operator engagement and no downstream error signature is consistent with a single monitor flapping (Alert → No Data → recovery).
Suggested next action: open the #alert-runtime-monitoring messages directly in Slack (links below) to recover the monitor identity — the bot can't read the block content. If it is the synthetics flap, mute or widen threshold.
